research_principles: Public portfolio disclosure, access to the delivery mechanism, reuse of factual observations, and reuse of proprietary additions are separate questions. None of the reviewed general website terms establishes that a paid data licence is necessary for the underlying factual holdings.

As a general US copyright principle, facts are not protected merely because an issuer reports them. Copyright in presentation or an original compilation does not itself establish ownership of every underlying fact. Applicable contractual terms, jurisdiction, database rights and third-party services require separate assessment.

Silence is neither a permission grant nor evidence that permission or payment is legally required. Record the specific route, material, operation, applicable conditions and proposed lawful-use basis before a production decision.

A proposed lawful-use basis may involve factual extraction with applicable-contract review, issuer-provided delivery terms, an explicit grant or an applicable statutory exception. A candidate basis is not a completed legal determination or source admission.

Preserve explicit website access restrictions, authentication and consent gates. Public facts do not authorize bypassing controls or disregarding applicable automation conditions. Continue permitted investigation without treating unresolved production rights as a ban on every research step.

Distinguish issuer-declared daily/full disclosure from independently measured completeness, as-of semantics, numerical eligibility and fund-specific regulatory reliance. Rule 6c-11 is not a universal assertion about every ETF; current official regulatory text and each fund reliance remain to be verified.

The permission summaries are scoped research findings, not executable authorization. Internal owner admission is a project gate, not an issuer licence. paid_licence_requirement remains not_established unless relevant affirmative evidence supports a different conclusion.

field_usage_profiles.review_basis: Candidate factual observations; assess the actual disclosure route and applicable access/use conditions without importing a blanket copyright claim over all facts.

Separate an identifier appearing in a disclosure from access to or redistribution of an identifier database, lookup service or mapping product. Identify relevant providers and field-specific conditions; no blanket licence requirement or blanket clearance is inferred.
Verify provider, methodology, meaning and reuse basis separately. Source sector labels are not the product taxonomy; country is not assumed to mean legal issuer domicile.

Raw-artifact retention, customer display and redistribution are distinct operations. A page or file can include protected expression or proprietary additions even when its underlying holdings observations are facts.
